name: Kravel Koalbeard
summary: At the Mirage Raceway in the Shimmering Flats, Kravel Koalbeard sees profit in the rivalry between gnome and goblin racers. He seeks coin through scavenged machine parts, blackmail, and schemes to sway race results.

sections.title: A Con Artist in the Flats
sections.body: At the Mirage Raceway, Kravel Koalbeard watches the crowds and crews for a chance to profit. He works among the raceway encampment, offering contracts and favors for motives rarely clean. The rivalry between gnome and goblin engineers gives him openings for extortion, sabotage, and theft.

sections.title: Rigging the Track
sections.body:
Kravel Koalbeard’s schemes reach beyond salvage on the salt flats. He sends willing adventurers to spread rumors, carry out blackmail, and get pit crews drunk before a race.

He may ply goblin mechanics with strong spirits or serve strong drinks to gnomish pilots. On race day, any underhanded trick may help fill his purse.

faq.answer: At the Mirage Raceway in the Shimmering Flats, Kravel Koalbeard schemes to profit from the rivalry between gnomes and goblins. He makes coin through salvage, race-fixing, and extortion.

faq.q: What does Kravel Koalbeard do at the Mirage Raceway?
faq.answer: Kravel hires travelers at the Mirage Raceway for underhanded errands. They collect rocket car parts, seek blackmail material, and get mechanics or pilots drunk to sway race results.

faq.q: Why is Kravel trying to get race crews drunk?
faq.answer: Kravel gets race crews drunk to influence races on which he wagers heavily. He targets gnomes or goblins according to which outcome promises the most profit.

faq.q: Where can Kravel Koalbeard be found?
faq.answer: Kravel Koalbeard can be found around the pit camps at the Mirage Raceway in the Shimmering Flats of Thousand Needles.

faq.q: Does Kravel have ties outside Thousand Needles?
faq.answer: Yes. Kravel’s dealings reach the goblin ports of Ratchet and Booty Bay. They include contacts tied to Ratchet’s Wharfmaster Dizzywig, rumormongers, and exotic brews from Stranglethorn Vale.

faq.q: Will Kravel work with both Alliance and Horde?
faq.answer: Kravel values gold above faction loyalty and employs both Alliance and Horde adventurers at the Mirage Raceway.

angles.text: Kravel is a rogue and swindler, unlike Ironforge’s honest miners, prospectors, and mountaineers. His conduct brings shame to traditional dwarven values.
As a gnome, watch your drinks and blueprints around Kravel. He is as ready to drug gnomish pilots as to sabotage their machines.
As a rogue, you may recognize Kravel’s methods: theft, sabotage, blackmail, and manipulating greedy targets from the shadows.
